label: Подруга
description: A 10-sentence usage card for подруга (girlfriend, female friend).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Подруга' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'живёт'. 'Моя' and 'лучшая' are feminine adjectives agreeing with it.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Подругу' is the accusative direct object of 'знаю'. Because it is an animate feminine noun, the accusative simply takes the -у ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Подруги' is genitive in the 'у' frame, showing whose car it is. The feminine genitive singular ending is -и after the soft stem.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Подруге' is the dative recipient of the gift, while 'шарф' is the accusative object of 'подарила'. A natural giving pattern.

missions.phrase: Я иду в кино с подругой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'С подругой' uses the instrumental form 'подругой' after 'с' to mean together with her. The feminine instrumental ending is -ой.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О подруге' uses the prepositional form 'подруге' after 'о' to express thinking about someone. The feminine ending shifts to -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Подруги' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'приедут'. 'Мои' is the agreeing plural possessive.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Подруги' is genitive after 'нет', expressing the lack of a close friend. 'Близкой' is the agreeing feminine genitive adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Подруге' is dative, the person being called, since 'позвонить' governs the dative. The feminine dative ending is -е.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantity word. 'Подруг' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. The feminine plural drops the vowel ending entirely.
